title: CaffeiNation
author: Michael Loegering
description: A text only adventure of a pathetic office drone's search for a cup of coffee.  Starting in a cubicle at "Data Entry & Diagnosics", the player must escape the clutches of Mr. Norom, the manager, and make his way to "CaffeiNation", the promised land flowing with espresso and half-and-half.  Along the way, there are adventures to be had at the local convenience store, the "Buy 'n Blow", the subway and in the local bookstore, "Gargantuan Lexicon".  Can you find the perfect cup before the sandman gets you?
